map.name: Hestle
map.setting: a farming town troubled by Ogres
map.trouble: Ogres have taken the old granary fort on Kroth Hill and come down every night to rob the farms of Hestle.

guard_bark.specifics: Tobb keeps the north gate of Hestle barred until Mayor Dulvane sends the player against the Ogres on Kroth Hill.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: This is the north gate of Hestle, and it stays shut.

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: The gate is open! Off with you, and hurry!

bounty_offer.specifics: Hoskin, a goat farmer, wants the giant leeches out of his well house and pays with the key to his boat on the river.

offer.speaker: Hoskin
offer.text: Sir! Over here, quick! Giant leeches have crawled up out of my well house south of the farm, and they've had my goats! Here, drink this if they bite you. Now get in there and kill the lot of them.

reminder.speaker: Hoskin
reminder.text: Why are you still standing about? My goats are thirsty!

completion.speaker: Hoskin
completion.text: Gone? Truly gone? Oh, thank goodness! Here, take the key to my boat. It's tied up down at the river. Use it whenever you like.

journal.text: Kill the giant leeches in Hoskin's well house.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Orlo, a stiff and grand old townsman, has had his amulet stolen by the Imps that nest in the ruined windmill.

offer.speaker: Orlo
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer. I find myself besieged by misfortune. Nefarious Imps have absconded with my amulet, and without it I am wholly defenceless against these abominable Ogres. Will you liberate it from those wretched creatures?

refusal.speaker: Orlo
refusal.text: How very disappointing. I had thought better of you.

reminder.speaker: Orlo
reminder.text: The Imps? I am told they nest in the old windmill west of town.

completion.speaker: Orlo
completion.text: My amulet! Splendid! Simply splendid! You have my most profound gratitude, brave Adventurer. Take these boots, with my compliments.

after.speaker: Orlo
after.text: Thanks again! I shall not let it out of my sight again, I assure you.

journal.text: Recover Orlo's amulet from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Orlo's amulet from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Hestle: Greda grumbles about the Mayor, Marl gives a tip about Ogre clubs, Hoskin warns of the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Greda
rumour1.text: Mayor Dulvane? The old windbag hasn't poked his nose out of the Town Hall since the Ogres came!

rumour2.speaker: Marl
rumour2.text: I've heard an Ogre's club will split a wooden shield clean in two. Get yourself something sturdier.

rumour3.speaker: Hoskin
rumour3.text: Beware of the north road after dark! The Ogres come down off the hill with torches.

shop_greeting.specifics: Hulda of the Sleepy Ox inn, Gorrick the smith, and Pidwick the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Hulda
inn.text: You want a room? Pay first. And wipe your boots, I just did the floors.

arms.speaker: Gorrick
arms.text: Welcome! I make armor for heroes and horseshoes for everybody else. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Pidwick
magic.text: Ahhh! A customer! Come in, come in! Everything's priced to sell, and what doesn't sell, I drink myself! Hee, hee, hee!

two_givers.specifics: Bramwell, a farmer, wants the Ogres run out of his barn; Sabble, a cider smuggler, wants his partner Rook broken out of the cellar under the Town Hall.

offer_a.speaker: Bramwell
offer_a.text:
Help! Ogres! There's Ogres in my barn!

They broke in last night. They've eaten the hay and now they're sleeping on what's left. I can't get near the place.

I'll tell you what. Run them off and I'll give you the old shield off my wall. Here's the key, the barn's west of the well. Go round the back.

offer_b.speaker: Sabble
offer_b.text:
Ahhh, now there's a face I can do business with! My partner Rook is locked up in Mayor Dulvane's cellar for carrying a few barrels of cider past the Ogres without paying the Mayor his tax, which is only a crime in Hestle and only since last spring and anyway somebody had to bring the cider in because nobody else would go near that road.

The cellar window at the back of the Town Hall has a loose bar. Pull it out and Rook can squeeze through.

You get him out, I'll find you something nice from the last load. No questions asked.

outcome_a.speaker: Bramwell
outcome_a.text:
My barn! They're gone! Thank you, thank you!

Here's the shield, as I promised. It came up out of my turnip field one spring. Never did find out whose it was.

outcome_b.speaker: Sabble
outcome_b.text: Rook's out?! Hah! Good work, friend! Here, this chain tunic is yours. Now I'd best go find him before the Mayor does.

journal_a.text: Drive the Ogres out of Bramwell's barn.

journal_b.text: Get Rook the smuggler out of the cellar under the Town Hall.

rescue.specifics: Sister Alwen's novices were carried off to the Ogre camp across the river; the novice Ebbin, found first, gives the key to the other's pen.

plea.speaker: Sister Alwen
plea.text: Oh, it's dreadful! The Ogres have carried off my novices! They're locked in the pens at the Ogre camp across the river. Go and bring them home!

reminder.speaker: Sister Alwen
reminder.text: Please, hurry! The Ogres will eat them!

found.speaker: Ebbin
found.text: Who's there?... Oh, thank goodness! One of the Ogres dropped this key. It opens the other pen. Take it, quick!

following.speaker: Ebbin
following.text: Lead on! I'm right behind you!

completion.speaker: Sister Alwen
completion.text:
My novices! Home safe! Bless you, kind sir, bless you! Take this as a token of my appreciation.

Mayor Dulvane has been asking after you. Go and see him at the Town Hall.

journal.text: Rescue Sister Alwen's novices from the Ogre camp.

main_opening.specifics: Greda points the player to Mayor Dulvane in the Town Hall, who hands him a sword and sends him to drive the Ogres from the granary fort on Kroth Hill.

herald.speaker: Greda
herald.text: Mayor Dulvane has been calling for help all morning! The Town Hall is in the middle of the village.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dulvane
opening.text:
So Vellis sent you. Good. There's no time for talk.

The Ogres have taken the old granary fort on Kroth Hill -- our own grain, in our own fort! Every night they come down and rob the farms.

Take this sword. Go up the hill and drive them out. Tobb will open the north gate for you.

journal.text: Drive the Ogres out of the granary fort on Kroth Hill.
